verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS email platform like Kit, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for users. The broadcast open/click stats and engagement scoring describe subscriber analytics features, not a user privacy control, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
